mechanism_narrative: A higher federal funds rate (as a continuous variable) is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to increased discount rates for equity valuation.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS is above its 50th percentile, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 5.0% signals a weak labor market, which is associated with reduced consumer spending and lower corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE > 5.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is rising (FEDFUNDS > 0.2% and increasing) and the CPI index is above 235 (indicating high inflation), the market anticipates a monetary tightening cycle that increases equity risk premiums, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction signal (FEDFUNDS>0.2% and CPIAUCSL>235) fails to produce negative returns in > 60% of instances, or Rank IC for interaction < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In a strong labor market regime (UNRATE < 4.0%), the low unemployment rate supports consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE < 4.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST < 1000.0) signals weak consumer demand and reduced construction activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where HOUST < 1000.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A low level of industrial production (INDPRO < 105.0) indicates a weakening economy, which is associated with reduced corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO < 105.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 0.2% (indicating a shift toward monetary tightening) is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to market anticipation of a rate cut in the near term.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 0.2%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential fixed investment (RSAFS > 440000.0) signals strong consumer demand and economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of instances where RSAFS > 440000.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.
